items.content_html: NodeSight is an AI-powered image analysis tool for the Pi ecosystem. Users can upload or capture photos, and the app instantly identifies objects, animals, plants, or products in the image. The system uses lightweight AI models optimized for distributed computing. NodeSight is mobile-first and optimized for Pi Browser for smooth performance.

items.content_html: Gimme Golf is a mobile-first web app that adds a fun side game to a real round of golf. Players track their normal score while also drawing hole-by-hole challenge cards, earning game points, and competing on an adjusted leaderboard. Built with React, TypeScript, and Vite, it’s designed to be lightweight, easy to use on the course.
